title: Wild West Chronicles
description:
S02 E04 — The Legend of Nat Love
When Black cowboy Nat Love overnights in Deadwood during a cattle drive, he decides to enter a Fourth of July cowboy competition; confident in his roping, riding, and shooting skills, he is eager to test his mettle against the best cowboys around.

title: Into the Wild Frontier
description:
S04 E05 — John Coffee Hays: A Texas Legend
Tennessee native John Coffee Hays heads to the frontier of Texas in the 1830s and signs on as an early member of the Texas Rangers, and in 1844 he becomes a legend when he leads a small band in a desperate fight with the Comanche.

title: The Cowboy Way: Alabama
description:
S03 E04 — Filet of Dreams
Bubba tries acupuncture to heal his broken sacrum; Misty solves the mystery behind her new herd's stillborn calves; Jaclyn entrusts Booger to handle Matthew; the cowboys pitch their steakhouse concept to a very skeptical restaurant owner.
